instruction: Fire ratings on walls may only be REI60 or REI90.
The load-bearing flag on walls should be optional rather than required, but if it is there it still has to be a yes/no value.
In the fire rating check, also require every wall to state its acoustic rating (the standard wall property, as text).
The fire rating requirement should only apply to external walls (walls whose IsExternal property is true).
Drop the load-bearing check entirely; we no longer need it.
These door checks must also be usable on IFC2X3 models, not only IFC4.
Rename the 'Door identification' check to 'Door naming'. Nothing else changes.
Door names must follow our numbering: 'D-' followed by exactly three digits, for example D-001.
Add a new check called "Door location": every door must be placed on a building storey.
In the door identification check, also require the overall door width to be between 0.8 m and 1.2 m.
Every space must also carry a reference code (the standard space Reference property, as an identifier).
Space numbers now start with one capital letter for the zone, followed by three digits (for example A101).
Some of our models have no spaces at all; that is fine. Only check spaces when the model has them.
Only apply the numbering rule to internal spaces (spaces of the INTERNAL type).
We no longer need the long name on spaces; remove that requirement and keep the numbering rule.
The classification system is now called 'ProjectCodes 2024' instead of 'ProjectCodes'.
Slab codes in that system must start with 'SL-'.
Apply the same classification rule to walls as well as slabs.
Add an explanation to the slab check for the people who read the report: 'Slabs are costed by their ProjectCodes classification.'
Columns must not just have any material: the material must be 'Concrete'.
Add a rule called "No proxy elements": the model must not contain any building element proxies.
Beams only need to be placed in the building, not necessarily on a storey.
Mark this requirement set as version 2.0.
Every column must also have its Tag (the element mark) filled in.
